git_guard.reset_hard_blocked: BLOCKED: git reset --hard discards all uncommitted changes permanently
git_guard.clean_blocked: BLOCKED: git clean -f permanently deletes untracked files
git_guard.checkout_blocked: BLOCKED: git checkout -- . / git restore . discards all working tree changes
git_guard.filter_repo_blocked: BLOCKED: git filter-repo --force overwrites working tree and purges reflog
git_guard.safe_alternative: Required: git stash → run command → git stash pop
